name: groundedness_multiselect
description: passage 하나를 보여주고 그 passage가 지지하는 atomic fact를 모두 선택

questions.prompt: Which statements are supported by this passage?
questions.none_option: None of the above is supported

instructions.title: Is each statement supported by the passage?
instructions.summary: Read a retrieved passage and mark which atomic statements it supports.
instructions.background: A QA system answered a question using retrieved passages. We split its answer into short atomic statements and want to know which ones each passage can verify on its own.
definitions: One short factual claim from the system's answer.
The passage explicitly states the claim or it follows directly. Related-but-unconfirmed is not supported.
howto: Read the question, then the passage.
Tick every supported statement, or None of the above.
instructions.tip: If this passage were the only thing you had read, could you confirm this exact statement?
